name: MISE (Meshing Isosurfaces by Extracting)
definition: Generates a 3D mesh from a trained DVR model by querying an implicit occupancy field using the MISE (Meshing Isosurfaces by Extracting) algorithm for adaptive resolution.
summary: MISE is an adaptive meshing algorithm that generates high-fidelity 3D triangle meshes from neural implicit models by querying an occupancy field, avoiding the computational cost of uniform voxel grids.
